items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: Woody, if he told us or, or just what he said.

ctx.x: Or did he have the whole band together at one time?

Well, that is, I mean, all the students gather in the, in the basement like, you know what I mean? And I just can't remember, Woody, if he told us or, or just what he said. But I mean, but, but I mean, I could remember this. I mean, if he had told me, if he had stopped me off that music had five lines in four spaces, I mean, I could remember that. But I don't think he told me that.
